record_scope_reconstruction: August22–28,2026 MAS sailing prohibition affected the Canawaima ferry route between Moleson Creek, Guyana, and South Drain, Suriname. The two landing sites represent the named international ferry link. This is not a closure of the entire river or all passenger crossings; Guyana continued immigration arrangements for small boats.

source_checks.finding: Full primary Guyana statement inspected: MAS demanded repairs, replacement proposal refused; small-boat passengers could still process immigration at Moleson Creek and New Nickerie.
Full primary August28 notice inspected: ban lifted and ferry service resumes that day on regular schedule, priority stranded passengers.
Full August22 NewsRoom report inspected: technical suspension; route explicitly Moleson Creek–South Drain.

Direct OSM XML inspected: way29231080 route=ferry, operator=Canawaima Ferry Service, motor vehicles and foot allowed, endpoints321516712 and29711119. XML sha256 bfb8fbaff90dcaf008f7679f7b409e95a6bdaf8d9e09f9fbaf1cb25b72aca2a7.
Direct OSM XML independently confirms ferry endpoint and Corentyne Highway landing connection, sha2564d37bada0c8651aa8316d365ae0cd2fad2262b5ab1012bc7c266c52ac4e552e7.
